text.content: A Imagine you are the people in one of the sets of pictures below. Tell a story that
explains what happened. Choose your own ending to the story.
B Tell your story to another pair. Can they think of another ending to your story?
Which ending do you like better?
"This really happened to us. We were driving down the road in our car. The weather
was very nice, and we were enjoying the ride. We were going to our friend's house.
We had a map, but suddenly...”
C Share your stories. Vote on the best one.
